mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active at all times based on the current rate level.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% in the last month, but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in the last month, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) signal an impending monetary policy tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (GDPC1 growth < 0% for the last quarter), a decline in residential investment (RSAFS) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 growth < 0%, a decline in RSAFS (more than 1% in the last month) leads to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) signals an impending monetary policy tightening, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When labor market growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5% month-over-month and manufacturing output (INDPRO) is below 100, the economy shows signs of a slowdown with rising labor costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightness with manufacturing weakness
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM and INDPRO < 100, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low manufacturing output (INDPRO < 100) compresses corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is active at all times based on the current INDPRO level.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100, but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 2% month-over-month signals weak consumer demand and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST declines by more than 2% MoM, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).
